claims: Lee Thompson Young was born in 1984.
Lee Thompson Young starred as the lead character in the Disney Channel series The Famous Jett Jackson from 1998 to 2001.
The Famous Jett Jackson ran for three seasons.
The Famous Jett Jackson is a Disney live-action show.
Silverstone is Jett Jackson's in-universe secret agent character.
The Movie is a Disney TV movie based on The Famous Jett Jackson.
Lee Thompson Young appeared in the Disney TV movie Johnny Tsunami.
Lee Thompson Young voiced a character in The Proud Family.
Raven-Symoné cited Lee Thompson Young as a "Disney Channel Legend".
Raven-Symoné cited Lee Thompson Young as an early trailblazer on the network.
